collection.description: An apprentice melts down a family heirloom, believing it to be scrap metal.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: An apprentice melts down a family heirloom, believing it to be scrap metal.

choices.label: Tell the full story through a new design

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The family is furious but accepts a sincere offer to rebuild the piece from remaining fragments.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The deception is discovered when the heirloom is requested; trust falls sharply.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The replacement preserves a surviving clasp and gains meaning, though the loss cannot be undone.
